The '''Makem Te fueling station''' was a [[refueling station]] in orbit around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] in the [[Makem system]].

==History==
The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] built the structure and placed it in orbit around the planet sometime after the mapping of the rimward portions of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The station had facilities for several crew members, and the Republic sent scientists to man it.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]] wrenched the station from its orbit and sent it crashing to the surface of Makem Te. It landed near the world's giant cemetery, [[Tract of Makem Te|the Tract]], just missing a direct collision.<ref name="GORW" />
